entries.title: Normalized Cardy crossing function
entries.statement: For 0<u<1 define C(u)=B(1/3,1/3)^(-1) integral_0^u [v(1-v)]^(-2/3)dv, where B(1/3,1/3) is the same integral from 0 to 1. Thus C(0)=0, C(1)=1, C'>0 and C''/C'=2(2u-1)/(3u(1-u)). This definition alone is not a claim that square-lattice crossing probabilities converge to C.

entries.title: DRAFT: two Cardy martingales identify the SLE 6 driver
entries.statement: Conditional reduction, independent review pending: let W be a continuous adapted real chordal Loewner driver, W_0=0, with dg_t(z)=2/(g_t(z)-W_t)dt in one usual filtration. For three real marks 0<a<b<c put X=g_t(a)-W_t and Y_i=g_t(b_i)-W_t, b_1=b,b_2=c. On each stopped compact localization with 0<X<Y_1<Y_2 and positive separations, assume BOTH C(X/Y_i) are local martingales, where C(u)=B(1/3,1/3)^(-1) integral_0^u [v(1-v)]^(-2/3)dv. Smooth inversion of the first makes W a semimartingale; the two Ito signed-measure equations force zero finite variation part and local martingale bracket 6dt. If the assumption holds for a countable mark/localization family covering every finite time, W/sqrt(6) is Brownian motion. The square-lattice martingale approximation needed to apply this reduction is unproved in this draft.
assumptions: both Cardy local martingales in the same filtration
covering family only for the global conclusion

entries.title: DRAFT: one Cardy martingale admits the wrong diffusion
entries.statement: Conditional counterexample, independent review pending: for kappa>=0, kappa!=6, fix 0<a<b<c and stop in 0<X<Y<Z. Solve locally dX=[2/X-beta]dt-sqrt(kappa)dB and dY=[2/Y-beta]dt-sqrt(kappa)dB with beta=(6-kappa)(1/X+1/Y)/3, X_0=a,Y_0=b. Set W=integral beta dt+sqrt(kappa)B and Z=g_t(c)-W. These X,Y are real Loewner marks for W. For C(u)=B(1/3,1/3)^(-1) integral_0^u [v(1-v)]^(-2/3)dv, C(X/Y) is a local martingale, although W has bracket kappa dt and nonzero drift. The second Cardy observable C(X/Z) has normalized drift (6-kappa)(1/Z-1/Y)/3, which is nonzero. This refutes only one-observable identification, not percolation conformal invariance.
assumptions: smooth locally Lipschitz SDE stopped before mark collision

entries.title: UNPROVED: stopped square bond Cardy approximation
entries.statement: Unproved model-specific input for square-lattice bond percolation at p=1/2 with precisely fixed Dobrushin exploration and boundary crossing events: on each positive-separation localization of marked Loewner coordinates 0<X_delta<Y_delta,1<Y_delta,2, the correctly oriented bounded conditional crossing martingales P_delta,i should satisfy E sup_{t<=T wedge tau_delta}|P_delta,i(t)-C(X_delta,t/Y_delta,i,t)| -> 0 as delta -> 0. Here C(u)=B(1/3,1/3)^(-1) integral_0^u [v(1-v)]^(-2/3)dv. Compatible joint driver/mark convergence and limiting filtration are also required. This draft provides no proof of this estimate; rotational symmetry, self-duality and a local parafermion equation do not by themselves establish it. No C0017 solution or novelty is claimed.

entries.title: Standard q 1 edge parafermion spin convention
entries.statement: Under the standard signed-radian edge parafermion convention F(e)=E[exp(i sigma W(e,e_b))1_{e in gamma}] with sigma in [0,1] satisfying sin(pi sigma/2)=sqrt(q)/2, q=1 gives sigma=1/3, since sin(pi/6)=1/2 and the sine is injective on that branch. The alternative exponent sigma-1 is -2/3. A positive spin 2/3 is not the standard branch; a different winding or conjugation convention must be stated explicitly. This elementary convention correction adds no missing analyticity estimate. Primary support is Definition 3 of Duminil-Copin, arXiv:1208.3787, and equation (1) of Zhou, arXiv:2409.03235v6.

relations.rationale: The two driver tests use the normalized Cardy function and its positive derivative.
The explicit incorrect diffusion preserves one test of this exact function.
The unproved lattice estimate compares its martingales to this function.
The wrong-kappa construction explains why the identification criterion uses two distinct boundary tests.
If proved with compatible joint convergence, the lattice estimate would supply the two martingales assumed by the conditional criterion.
This explicitly unproved input concerns identification of the square-bond exploration scaling limit in C0017.
The standard-branch convention is needed when using the historical C0017 parafermion attempt; its unqualified positive 2/3 spin requires correction or an explicit alternative convention.
